'''Cardo''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sedrian]] [[High Priest of the Golden Sun]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. He had a son named [[Pek]].

==Biography==
[[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] Cardo was leader of the [[Sedrian]] people, a devoted adherent to the [[Sedrian religion]], and caretaker of the [[sun caves]]. His son, [[Pek]], was also a [[Priest/Legends|priest]]. Cardo took his role seriously, and intended to keep the [[Golden Sun]] apart from the commoners, believing that they should not be allowed direct contact with it although he honestly believed he knew what was best for his people. He also refused to believe that the Golden Sun was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being in its own right, keeping it prisoner beneath the [[Great Shell Dome]] in [[Fitsay]]. Cardo studied the mysteries of the Golden Sun, which he passed on to his son Pek.<ref name="BGS" />

Cardo did not understand Karak's grievances about the Golden Sun, truly believing that his way of handling the Golden Sun was correct. Despite seeing Karak's motives for what they were&mdash;wanting control of the Golden Sun for himself&mdash;Cardo was still saddened and confused over his actions. When Kark stole a piece of [[Golden Sun coral|coral]] from the sun caves, Cardo had the [[warrior monk]]s drive Karak and his followers out of Fitsay.<ref name="BGS" />

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on Sedri, Cardo did not known how much danger they posed to his people. The Hight Priest knew that they were evil, branding them "[[Fish/Legends|fish]]-killers" but decided to wait to see what they wanted before deciding on a course of action. As a pacifist, Cardo did not want to commit his people to war or violence, trusting in the mysteries of the Golden Sun and for the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] to fend for themselves.<ref name="BGS" />

His son, Pek, brought [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to meet Cardo. He received them in the [[Audience Hall]], and answered their questions, telling them about Karak and his renegades, as well as the newly-arrived Imperials. He remained coy when asked about the Golden Sun, saying that was a matter only for Sedrians, and also had no information about an Alliance dignitary who was lost on their world, [[Mors Odrion]]. After the audience, Cardo forbade his son from guiding the Alliance team to the [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]].<ref name="BGS" />

During the [[Battle of Fitsay]], Cardo tried to stop the former [[bishop of war]], [[Karak]], from entering the [[sun caves]] where the [[Golden Sun]] was located, but was nearly killed when one of [[Karak's renegades]] slashed him across the chest. Following the victory over Karak's renegades, and the discovery of the true [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] nature of the [[Golden Sun]], Cardo was succeeded as High Priest by Pek and [[Fala (Sedrian)|Fala]] who intended to make sure Cardo paid for his misguided deeds.<ref name="BGS" />

==Personality and traits==
Cardo was one of the largest Sedrians, and was happy, peaceful, and wanted nothing more than to lead his people and study the Golden Sun. A pacifist, he preferred that the [[warrior monk]]s only used their [[spear gun]]s as a last resort.<ref name="BGS" />

==Equipment==
Cardo wore a heavy [[Gold/Legends|golden]] [[circlet]] with an ornate [[Coral/Legends|coral]] pattern on it. He also carried a [[Scepter/Legends|scepter]]<ref name="BGS" />
